status_reason: The design, stimuli, timing, trial counts and the paper's measure are Experiment 2's as published; the changes (typed instead of spoken reports, a keyboard start, whole-frame timing, self-paced rests) are listed as deviations and do not change what is measured.

original.citation: Raymond, J. E., Shapiro, K. L., & Arnell, K. M. (1992). Temporary suppression of visual processing in an RSVP task: An attentional blink? Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance, 18(3), 849-860.
original.experiments: Experiment 2 (target identification with probe detection, and the ignore-target control)

assets.what: Illustrative stimulus preview drawn by src/raymond1992/preview.py from configs/task.yaml: the whole display at scale and a strip of successive letter frames (each shown alone, 15 ms on, 75 ms grey). Display values, not calibrated luminance.

notes: Needs a display at 100, 120, 144, 200 or 240 Hz for the paper's timing (60 Hz is refused in run mode), and a gamma-corrected display whose white luminance is entered in configs/task.yaml. Software-verified only; no participant data.
